title: ever SCARLEN|Satin V-Neck Flutter Sleeve Midi Bridesmaid Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Crafted in lustrous satin, this elegant dress features a flattering V-neckline, soft flutter sleeves, and a graceful hi-lo hem that moves beautifully with every step. The defined waist enhances the silhouette while the rich burgundy tone offers timeless sophistication¡ªideal for coordinated bridal parties or polished wedding guest looks.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
